portfolioTips.title: Curate a portfolio that commands premium rates
portfolioTips.subtitle: High-paying clients don't browse — they feel trust in seconds. Shape your CraftLink profile like a gallery, not a dump folder.
portfolioTips.step1Desc: Your first three pieces set the tone. Choose projects that reflect the clients you want — not everything you've ever made.
portfolioTips.step2Title: Tell the story behind each piece
portfolioTips.step2Desc: Context converts browsers into buyers. Briefly note the challenge, your role, and the outcome.
portfolioTips.step3Desc: Consistent crops, spacing, and tone signal professionalism. Chaos reads as amateur.
portfolioTips.step4Desc: Tag skills and categories honestly. Premium clients search for experts, not generalists.
portfolioTips.step5Desc: Replace weaker pieces quarterly. A living portfolio signals you're active and selective.
portfolioTips.beforeAfterSubtitle: Tap each card to see how small changes elevate perception
portfolioTips.example3After: Specific tagline: 'Wabi-sabi brand systems for lifestyle brands'

pricingGuide.subtitle: Understand hourly vs. value-based pricing, platform fees, and what you actually take home after escrow releases.

about.title: Bridging craft with global opportunity
about.subtitle: CraftLink was born from a simple belief: exceptional design deserves exceptional trust — and the calm, deliberate spirit of Japanese craftsmanship.
about.takumiDesc: Takumi is the artisan who pursues mastery not for fame, but for the integrity of the work itself. We built CraftLink to honor that mindset — connecting clients who value quality with creatives who embody it.
about.timeline1Desc: Frustrated by chaotic freelance platforms, our founders envisioned a calmer marketplace inspired by wabi-sabi and escrow clarity.
about.timeline2Desc: Milestone escrow, portfolio-first discovery, and bilingual support unite creatives and clients across borders.
about.timeline3Desc: Thousands of designers, illustrators, and brand artists build sustainable careers with transparent payments and respectful collaboration.
about.value1Desc: Interfaces and flows that reduce anxiety — for both sides of every project.
about.value2Desc: Escrow, milestones, and clear policies — never surprise fees or vague delivery.
about.value3Desc: We celebrate depth and artistry, not race-to-the-bottom gigs.

trustSafety.title: Trust woven into every transaction
trustSafety.subtitle: Escrow, milestones, intellectual property safeguards, and fair dispute resolution — designed so you can focus on the work.

accordion.escrowContent: When a client places an order, the full budget is held in CraftLink escrow — not released to the freelancer until you approve each milestone or final delivery. Funds are never sent directly between parties, eliminating payment risk.
accordion.milestoneContent: Work progresses through Concept (30%), Draft (40%), and Final (30%) stages. Freelancers upload deliverables per stage; clients review and approve before partial release. Revision policies are agreed upfront in the project brief.
accordion.ipContent: Upon final acceptance and full payment release, IP transfers to the client as defined in the order terms. Until acceptance, creators retain ownership. Source files are delivered through secure, watermarked channels during review.
accordion.disputeContent: If work falls materially short of the agreed brief, either party may open a dispute within the review window. Our team reviews evidence, messages, and milestone history to recommend mediation, partial refund, or continued revision — fairly and promptly.
accordion.deliveryContent: Final files use expiring download links and optional watermarks during the 3–5 day review period. Clicking 'Accept & Release Payment' unlocks full-resolution assets and releases remaining escrow automatically.
